title: GoldenEye
about: Bond races to stop a former friend from using a stolen Soviet satellite weapon.
cue: Serve the drinks when Bond orders his vodka martini at the casino in Monte Carlo.
faces: The vodka is on me, Mr. Bond. The information will cost you.
